title: Bosephus 2050
dek: Not an agent. A machine that builds a narrative on a cited record, keeps a visible seam between the two halves, and leaves falsifiable markers so it can be graded.
quote: PIVOT DETECTION. The catalyst a branch hangs on: named, dated, and specific enough that you could go and stand where it happens and watch it fire. Graded binary. Anyone can post a score.
